title: A goal research story's check reads its narrowed questions' coverage, not only that a work commit exists
goal: The check of a goal research story reads each question its narrowed goal names (rag.py pack coverage, or a gap entry for it), so done refuses research that left a question unanswered: at SP-4phd36pa, backlog.py researched ST-bivdc2fa proved only a work commit, and only the fresh-context review read the seven clauses (it found four S3 wording gaps, BG-az4r47gd, BG-lmp4mxmo, BG-drzst6zj, BG-o2spkwnz).
notes: Filed as a retrospective draft at the SP-4phd36pa close; its check names a test not written yet (it collects none and fails until the work adds it), within the ceiling or merged into an existing test when planned. SP-ajcomz6d close (2026-10-11): researched passed on the first work commit; only the fresh-context review found two S2 gaps (BG-ab3tndhy, a summary contradicting its own table; BG-i44ewtyl, AlmaLinux 8 and 10 half-answered with no gap) and two S3.
